prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Verify Desktop Pet Visibility", "Ensure desktop display permissions are granted so your companion can roam over your active desktop windows.", "Enable Desktop Overlay Permission", "Preparing desktop overlay permissions..."]
1: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Learn quick mouse shortcuts and tray commands to summon, chat with, or hide your companion anytime.", "Tray Controls & Keyboard Shortcuts"]
2: ["Sign In to Save & Sync Your Pets", "Logging in ensures your adopted companions are synchronized across reinstalls and devices.", "Cloud Pet Recovery Active"]
3: ["Review Your Generated Companion", "Check your companion's custom portrait before finalizing the official adoption certificate.", "Your companion photo has been confirmed!"]
4: ["Sign In to Restore Existing Pets", "Use your primary login to restore saved pets and avoid creating duplicate empty accounts."]
5: ["Building High-Res Desktop Sprites", "Rendering full desktop animations. Estimated time under 2 minutes."]
6: ["For best results, upload clear, well-lit photos with a single subject facing forward."]
7: ["Select Your Path & Claim Starter Pet Items", "Every path unlocks exclusive desktop pet accessories and interactive toys.", "Includes Free Accessory Pack"]
8: []
9: ["You can minimize this app. We will send a system notification when your pet lands on your desktop!"]
